description: 부산광역시_상수도 공사 현황 [drinking water supply] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 부산광역시. 부산광역시 상수도 사업본부에서 시행하는 공사현황을 개방합니다. 상수도 공사는 깨끗하고 안정적인 물공급을 위해 상수도 시설을 설치, 보수, 확장 하는 공사를 말합니다. Coverage: 부산광역시. The portal files it under the publisher 부산광역시. Its tags are 상수도, 시공사, 공사현황, 착공일, 완료일. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
